streets_lima

streets_arequipa
Walkable Street Network of Arequipa (Historic Center / Yanahuara)

Topological Diagnostics

Inspect user-supplied street networks for connectivity, dead ends, and undershoots without mutating geometries.

walk_diagnose_network()
Topological and Health Diagnosis for Street Networks
print(<walk_diagnosis>)
Print Method for Street Network Diagnosis
plot(<walk_diagnosis>)
Plot Method for Street Network Diagnosis

Rust Acceleration Kernels

Low-level compiled Rust routines for CSR conversion and parallel Dijkstra search.

rust_build_csr()
Build Compressed Sparse Row (CSR) graph representation. Drops self-loops, collapses parallel edges to minimum travel time, and returns CSR structures along with connected component analysis.
rust_compute_reachable_length()
Compute reachable walkable network length in parallel for a set of target nodes.
rust_compute_circuity_sample()
Compute detour ratio (circuity) for sampled origin-destination pairs.
rust_shortest_path()
Compute shortest path between source and target nodes using Dijkstra.
rust_isochrone_subgraph()
Extract reachable edges and nodes within cutoff time from an origin node.
rust_compute_access_multi()
Compute cumulative POI accessibility for target nodes in parallel.
